subject: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cardionova.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Liang <sasha.liang@cardionova.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this on. We're excited to get streaming outputs, function/tool callbacks, and structured JSON outputs live for our triage workflow. Attached is a short requirements doc that shows the fields we need in the live output and our target latency window.

High-level asks:
- Confirm Redwood can support streaming token-by-token output with tool hooks invoked on sentence boundary events.
- Share a proposed sprintboard with checkpoint dates (schema freeze, test harness, production smoke).
- Tell us what sample schema we should provide (we've attached an example payload).

We'd like a kickoff call week of 11/8 if possible.

Attachments: [Attachment: cardio_onboarding_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, CardioNova
alex.mercer@cardionova.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cardionova.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints

Alex —

Appreciate the concise requirements. Quick responses inline and a proposed next step list below.

1) Streaming + tool hooks: yes — Redwood supports chunked streaming and we can emit toolcall events at sentence or punctuation boundaries. We typically recommend sending tool call definitions as part of the schema so we can validate at schema-freeze.

2) Sprintboard: attached is a sprintboard template I use for partner enablement. Proposed checkpoints:
   - 11/10: schema freeze (CardioNova provides canonical sample payloads)
   - 11/17: integration sandbox completed (end-to-end streaming + toolcall smoke)
   - 11/24: performance run + security checklist (SOC checklist and audit logs)
   - 12/01: production cutover window

3) Sample schema: please include a minimal live_output JSON + toolcall map (we can consume either array-of-events or streamed JSONL). If you can attach a single representative record (one full interaction) that covers all output types (text, toolcall, structured metadata), that will speed validation.

I've looped in Camila (CS handoff lead) and Dylan (runtime lead) to handle the rollout tasks.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll provision a sandbox project by 11/4 and share API keys.
- Camila will send an onboarding checklist and access matrix.
- Dylan will schedule a short call to review expected load patterns.

Attached: redwood_sprintboard_template.xlsx

Are you ok with the 11/10 schema freeze? If so we'll lock dates.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints

Vanessa / team —

Quick internal notes before we lock dates:
- We need CardioNova to confirm whether toolcall side-effects require synchronous responses (blocking) or async callbacks. That affects runtime routing and timeout settings.
- Rishi, please pre-validate the sample schema for any reserved field names (we should avoid top-level keys named "session" or "token" which collide with our internal telemetry).
- Dylan, plan for a smoke test that includes KV-cache priming and a perf run at 20 qps for 5 min to validate batching behavior.

I'll draft the onboarding checklist and send it to Alex with clear access steps (who needs Sandbox API key, who should have logs access).

-Camila

On Mon, Nov 1, 2026 at 12:45 PM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex —
>
> Appreciate the concise requirements. Quick responses inline and a proposed next step list below.
>
> ...
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cardionova.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Liang <sasha.liang@cardionova.ai>, legal@cardionova.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints

Vanessa / team —

Thanks, that's great. Answers below:
- Toolcalls: we expect async callbacks (non-blocking). The orchestration will accept an event and then post back results to our callback URI.
- Schema: attached is a sample schema file and one representative record. We name the top-level payload "live_event" (hope that's ok).
- Dates: 11/10 schema freeze works for us.

We also have a procurement item — an amendment to the contract to add a production SLA for streaming endpoints. I've CC'd legal; Sasha will follow up if DocuSign is needed.

Attachments: [Attachment: cardionova_live_output_schema.json (json)]
Links: HubSpot deal https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4389

Alex
Head of Integrations, CardioNova
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cardionova.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration Sprintboard: Streaming, Tool Hooks, Schema Checkpoints

Alex / Sasha —

Thanks for the updates and for the schema file. Confirming the sprintboard and next steps below — I also created a shared drive folder with the onboarding artifacts.

Sprintboard (confirmed):
- 2026-11-10: Schema freeze — CardioNova delivers final canonical sample records and toolcall URI shapes. (Owner: CardioNova)
- 2026-11-17: Sandbox E2E smoke (streaming + async callbacks) — Redwood to provision sandbox and API keys by 11/04. (Owner: Redwood)
- 2026-11-24: Performance & security checks — Redwood to run perf at 20 qps and produce telemetry report. CardioNova to validate log formats. (Owner: Redwood / CardioNova)
- 2026-12-01: Production cutover window — coordinated change control and runbook execution. (Owner: Joint)

Action items:
- Vanessa: share sandbox API key and create Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_redwood_cardionova_kickoff) — will do by 11/04.
- Camila: onboarding checklist and access matrix posted to Drive.
- Dylan & Rishi: schedule a 30-min tech review on 11/09 to walk streaming mechanics and timeout semantics.
- CardioNova: sign the amendment (DocuSign link below) or confirm counterparty details.

DocuSign (amendment): https://www.docusign.com/contract/5f3a8c
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4389

If that looks good I'll schedule the 11/09 tech review and the 11/10 schema freeze milestone into the sprintboard. Looking forward to the kickoff call.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
